title: Satellite Intelligence: Distributed Training, Collaborative Inference,and LLM Adaptation in LEO Constellation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The proliferation of orbital sensing data and the real-time demands of emerging global services are pushing low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks from bent-pipe relays toward intelligent onboard processing. This shift confronts a fundamental tension, where modern artificial intelligence (AI) training paradigms require intensive computation, abundant memory, and stable connectivity, all of which are scarce under the dynamic topologies, intermittent links, and severe size, weight, and power (SWaP) constraints of satellite networks. Addressing this tension demands rethinking AI workflows, from training and inference to the emerging deployment of large language models (LLMs), under a constraint-aware design philosophy. To the best of our knowledge, this paper provides the first survey that jointly covers all three, whereas prior surveys examine these aspects in isolation. translated_title: 卫星智能：低轨星座中的分布式训练、协同推理与大语言模型适配
translated_abstract: 轨道传感数据的激增以及新兴全球服务的实时需求，正推动低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络从弯管式中继向智能星上处理转变。这一转变面临一个根本性矛盾：现代人工智能（AI）训练范式需要密集的计算、充足的内存和稳定的连接，而这些资源在卫星网络的动态拓扑、间歇性链路以及严格的体积、重量与功耗（SWaP）约束下都极为稀缺。要化解这一矛盾，需要以约束感知的设计理念重新审视AI工作流，涵盖从训练、推理到大语言模型（LLM）新兴部署的完整流程。据我们所知，本文是首个同时涵盖这三个方面的综述，而以往的综述仅对这些方面进行孤立考察。文章首先识别了卫星智能的部署挑战……
tldr: 本文首次提出同时涵盖低轨卫星网络中分布式训练、协同推理与大语言模型部署三个方向的综述，并在动态拓扑、间歇链路与严格SWaP约束下确立了约束感知的卫星AI设计理念。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first survey jointly covering distributed training, collaborative inference, and LLM deployment in LEO satellite constellations, establishing a constraint-aware design philosophy for satellite AI under dynamic topologies, intermittent links, and strict SWaP constraints.
